description: Admin dashboard and the animated landing page. Role-gated (admin) routes; Cloudinary signed uploads; product create/edit/deactivate APIs + UI reflected on the storefront; admin order list with new-orders indicator and validated status advancement firing customer notifications; and the Framer Motion staggered dark landing hero per design.md §9 (respecting prefers-reduced-motion, responsive). Covers tasks.md tasks 11, 12, 13. Depends on FEAT-003 (products/storefront) and FEAT-004 (orders.ts transition map + notify).
steps: Create src/lib/cloudinary.ts: configure from CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME/API_KEY/API_SECRET; signUploadParams() returning {timestamp, signature, apiKey, cloudName, folder} for a direct signed client upload; deleteImage(publicId).
Create src/app/api/uploads/route.ts (POST, requireAdmin): return the signed upload params for the client Cloudinary widget/direct upload.
Add the POST (admin create) branch to src/app/api/products/route.ts: requireAdmin, productSchema validate, create Product with the Cloudinary imageUrl + imagePublicId.

Create src/app/api/products/[id]/route.ts: GET (detail), PATCH (requireAdmin: edit name/description/dialColor/priceKobo/stock/isActive), DELETE (requireAdmin: soft-delete via isActive=false and optionally cloudinary deleteImage).
Create src/app/(admin)/admin/layout.tsx enforcing requireAdmin() (redirect non-admins); brand-themed admin shell.

Build src/app/(admin)/admin/products/page.tsx: product list + add form (name, description, dialColor, priceKobo, stock, image upload to Cloudinary via /api/uploads then save), edit (price/name/stock), remove/deactivate. Create src/components/admin/product-form.tsx.

Create src/app/api/orders/[id]/status/route.ts (POST, requireAdmin): validate the requested transition against the allowed-transition map in src/lib/orders.ts; write Order.status, append OrderStatusEvent, and fire the customer notify() for that transition (approve/processing/shipped/delivered/cancel).

Build src/app/(admin)/admin/orders/page.tsx: list all orders (customer, items, total, address, current status) with buttons to advance/cancel; and src/app/(admin)/admin/page.tsx dashboard home showing a new-orders indicator (count of orders in PAID not yet APPROVED).

Landing hero: replace the placeholder src/app/page.tsx with the animated hero (keep it at '/'; a (marketing) route group is optional). Create src/components/landing-hero.tsx ('use client') using framer-motion motion + variants + staggerChildren: hero-watch.jpg scales/fades to center (opacity 0->1, y 40->0, scale 0.9->1); 'Dawns Embrace' wordmark + motto 'A new day, a new you' rise in; lineup-left.jpg fades from left (x -40->0) and lineup-right.jpg fades from right (x 40->0); 'Proceed to Order' button -> /shop. Use next/image from /public/brand, the brand palette, useReducedMotion for a static fallback, and a responsive layout (stack on mobile).
acceptance_criteria: All (admin) routes and admin APIs are role-gated via requireAdmin(); non-admins are redirected/forbidden.
Admin can add a product with a Cloudinary-uploaded image, edit price/name/stock, and deactivate it; the storefront reflects the changes.
Admin order list shows customer/items/total/address/status with a new-orders indicator; status advancement validates allowed transitions and fires a customer notification each time.

The landing page renders the Framer Motion staggered hero (center watch, wordmark + motto, two side lineups, Proceed to Order -> /shop), uses the brand palette, is responsive, and falls back to a static layout under prefers-reduced-motion.
'npx tsc --noEmit', 'npx next lint', and 'npx next build' all pass.

findings:
DONE. Verification: prisma generate OK, tsc --noEmit clean, next lint clean (0 warnings/errors), next build succeeded (10/10). DB not run (no local Postgres, per context.json fallback). Build output: /admin, /admin/orders, /admin/products are ƒ (force-dynamic); /api/uploads, /api/products, /api/products/[id], /api/orders/[id]/status are ƒ dynamic; landing / is ○ static (client hero mounts via framer-motion).

ROLE-GATING (all held):
- (admin) ROUTES: src/app/(admin)/admin/layout.tsx calls `await requireAdmin()` from @/lib/session, which redirects guests AND non-ADMINs to /login. Every admin page (dashboard/products/orders) nests under it, so all (admin) routes are gated at the layout.
- ADMIN APIs: /api/uploads (POST), /api/products (POST branch), /api/products/[id] (PATCH+DELETE), /api/orders/[id]/status (POST) each use getCurrentUser() and return 401 (no session) / 403 (role!=='ADMIN'). NOTE: used getCurrentUser()+explicit JSON 401/403 in API handlers instead of requireAdmin() because requireAdmin() calls next/navigation redirect(), which is for pages/server components, not JSON APIs. GET /api/products and GET /api/products/[id] stay public (storefront read side).

CLOUDINARY (src/lib/cloudinary.ts, uses cloudinary@2.11.0):
- signUploadParams() lazily configures the SDK from CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME/API_KEY/API_SECRET and returns {timestamp, signature, apiKey, cloudName, folder}. Signature = cloudinary.utils.api_sign_request({folder, timestamp}, apiSecret) — covers exactly folder+timestamp, the params the client must echo back. Folder is 'dawns-embrace/products'. API_SECRET never leaves the server.
- deleteImage(publicId) is best-effort (try/catch, logs, never throws) so a failed Cloudinary cleanup can't block the product op. DELETE /api/products/[id] calls it after the soft-delete.
- UPLOAD FLOW is direct-to-Cloudinary: product-form.tsx POSTs /api/uploads for signed params, then uploads the File straight to https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/<cloud>/image/upload (file bytes never pass through our server), then POSTs secure_url+public_id to /api/products.

PRODUCT APIs:
- POST /api/products: admin-gated, validates productSchema (prices in KOBO), creates Product with imageUrl+imagePublicId.
- /api/products/[id]: GET public detail (404 if missing); PATCH admin edit via new productUpdateSchema in @/lib/validation (all fields optional, .refine requires >=1 field; imagePublicId nullable); DELETE admin SOFT-delete (isActive=false, preserves order history) + best-effort deleteImage. Next 15 params is a Promise — awaited.
- NEW SCHEMA: `import { productUpdateSchema, type ProductUpdateInput } from '@/lib/validation'` for partial admin edits.
- Storefront reflects changes because listActiveProducts() filters isActive:true and reads live priceKobo/stock; admin products page lists ALL products (active+inactive) so hidden ones remain visible to admins.

ORDER STATUS (admin):
- POST /api/orders/[id]/status: admin-gated, validates body with orderStatusSchema, delegates to advanceStatus(id, status, note) from @/lib/orders (FEAT-004) which validates via ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS/canTransition, writes Order.status + appends OrderStatusEvent in a $transaction, then fires the customer notify(). Returns 400 on an invalid transition (advanceStatus ok:false). Each approve/processing/shipped/delivered/cancel therefore notifies the customer exactly once.
- admin/orders/page.tsx lists every order (customer email/name, items, total, address, current status) and renders OrderActions with nextStatuses=ORDER_STATUS_TRANSITIONS[status] computed server-side, so the UI only offers valid transitions (the API re-validates regardless). admin/page.tsx dashboard shows the new-orders indicator = count of orders in status PAID (paid, awaiting approval), per design §8.

LANDING HERO (design §9): src/app/page.tsx now renders <LandingHero/> ('use client', src/components/landing-hero.tsx) kept at '/'. framer-motion motion.div with a container variant using staggerChildren(0.25)+delayChildren. Sequence: hero-watch (opacity 0->1, y 40->0, scale 0.9->1) -> 'Dawns Embrace' wordmark + 'A new day, a new you' motto rise in (y 24->0) -> lineup-left from left (x -40->0) + lineup-right from right (x 40->0) -> 'Proceed to Order' button -> /shop. next/image fill from /public/brand/{hero-watch,lineup-left,lineup-right}.jpg (priority on hero). useReducedMotion() -> when reduced, initial='show' so everything renders in final state with no animation (static fallback). Responsive: side lineups stack (flex-col) under the hero on mobile, row (sm:flex-row) on larger screens. Brand palette: bg-gulf-blue surface, persian-blue accents, brand-white text.

NOTE: next.config.ts already allow-lists res.cloudinary.com for next/image, so uploaded product images render on the storefront without further config. requireAdmin()'s non-admin branch currently redirects to /login (per FEAT-002/session.ts); acceptable for gating though a dedicated 403 page could be nicer later.
